subject: Music Production
title: Gain Staging Fundamentals
description: A 60-second lesson on Gain Staging Fundamentals.

hook.text: A mix with fifty tracks can easily clip and distort if volume levels are not managed carefully.

buildup.text: Gain staging means setting the volume of each track at every processing stage to avoid overload.

discovery.text: Proper gain staging gives plug-ins clean signals to work with, producing better-sounding results.

twist.text: Many home producers skip gain staging, then wonder why their mixes sound muddy and distorted.

climax.text: Professional engineers consider gain staging the invisible foundation that supports an entire mix.

punchline.text: Clean levels at every stage build a cleaner mix.

quiz.question: What is gain staging?
options: Making every track as loud as possible
Setting proper volume levels at every processing stage
Adding gain to the master output
